summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K disclosing exchange agreements with holders of its Series C-1 Convertible Notes. On September 25, 2026, noteholders swapped Existing Notes for equivalent principal of new Series D Convertible Notes under Section 3(a)(9). The conversion price dropped from $12.00 to $2.45, plus an alternative 93%-of-lowest-VWAP conversion feature. The Series D Notes carry 4.5% interest (13% on default), mature in 18 months at a 13% premium, and amortization begins January 1, 2027. A 4.99% beneficial ownership cap applies.
